description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component, validating request rejection, decision evaluation based on security and allowlist conditions, and related helper functions.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating the behavior of ExecHostRequestEvaluator in various scenarios.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that a request with an empty command array is rejected as invalid.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Checks that evaluation requests a prompt when allowlist conditions are not satisfied and no prior decision is made.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Verifies that the evaluator allows a one-time allow decision when allowlist is not satisfied but an allowOnce decision is provided.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Ensures that the evaluator denies execution when an explicit deny decision is given.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Helper function to create different evaluation contexts based on security settings, ask method, and satisfaction flags.
